import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,unittest,io
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();rules=root/'scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py';recipes=root/'scripts/gmyhf_statement_fixes.py';pipe=root/'scripts/repair_gmyhf_sample_findings.py'
originals={p:p.read_text() for p in (rules,recipes,pipe)}
cases=[
(rules,'允许前导零',"return source.replace(old,'return expressions_model(text, False)')","return source.replace(old,'return expressions_model(text, True)')",'test_gmyhf_review_fixes.ReviewRulesTests.test_expression_reference_without_leading_zeros_against_all_separators'),
(rules,'目标上界差一','legal = max(-2**31,min(2**31-1,target))','legal = max(-2**31,min(2**31,target))','test_gmyhf_review_fixes.ReviewRulesTests.test_meeting_endpoints_and_signed_target_bounds'),
(rules,'错误去掉数字串的前导零',"return f'{digits}\\n{legal}\\n'.encode()","return f'{int(digits)}\\n{legal}\\n'.encode()",'test_gmyhf_review_fixes.ReviewRulesTests.test_meeting_endpoints_and_signed_target_bounds'),
(rules,'仍使用禁止的起点',"return f'{m} {n}\\n1 2\\n'.encode()","return payload",'test_gmyhf_review_fixes.ReviewRulesTests.test_meeting_endpoints_and_signed_target_bounds'),
(recipes,'题面把禁止写为允许','操作数不应该包含前导零','操作数应该包含前导零','test_gmyhf_statement_fixes.StatementFixTests.test_trapezoid_sample_and_explicit_no_leading_zero_rule'),
(recipes,'梯形样例仍填16',"answers[1],result['sampleOutput']","'16',result['sampleOutput']",'test_gmyhf_statement_fixes.StatementFixTests.test_trapezoid_sample_and_explicit_no_leading_zero_rule'),
(recipes,'表达式样例重复首组','m[1].strip() for m in re.finditer','m[0].strip() for m in re.finditer','test_gmyhf_statement_fixes.StatementFixTests.test_expression_samples_are_split_in_the_original_order'),
(pipe,'题面复算仍用旧参考',"source = review_rules.no_leading_zero_reference(proof['source']) if number==30236 else proof['source']","source = proof['source']",'test_gmyhf_statement_fixes.FollowupWriterTests.test_tenth_batch_uses_the_confirmed_reference_and_preserves_data'),
(pipe,'误报参考哈希未变化',"'reference_sha256':sha((local/'reference.py').read_bytes())","'reference_sha256':entry['authored_reference']['sha256']",'test_gmyhf_statement_fixes.FollowupWriterTests.test_tenth_batch_uses_the_confirmed_reference_and_preserves_data'),
(pipe,'题面误用上一批数据回执',"else 'collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch10.json'","else 'collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch9.json'",'test_gmyhf_statement_fixes.FollowupWriterTests.test_tenth_batch_uses_the_confirmed_reference_and_preserves_data')]
results=[]
try:
 for p,name,old,new,test in cases:
  assert originals[p].count(old)==1,(name,originals[p].count(old));p.write_text(originals[p].replace(old,new))
  run=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3.11','-B','-m','unittest','tests.'+test],capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
  assert run.returncode!=0,name
  results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'exit_code':run.returncode});p.write_text(originals[p])
finally:
 for p,s in originals.items():p.write_text(s)
sys.path.insert(0,str(root));from tests.test_gmyhf_review_fixes import ReviewRulesTests
from unittest.mock import patch
entry=next(e for e in json.loads((root/'collab/gmyhf-pending-batch11-review.json').read_text())['entries'] if e['global_number']==21729)
source=entry['authored_reference']['source'].split('import sys\nsys.stdout.write')[0].replace('range(1, m - n + j + 1)','range(1, m - n + 1)')
ns={};exec(source,ns)
with patch.object(ReviewRulesTests,'reference',return_value=ns['meeting_one']):
 result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(ReviewRulesTests('test_trapezoid_reference_against_all_monotone_paths'));assert not result.wasSuccessful()
results.append({'mutation':'梯形路径误按矩形宽度','detected':True,'failures':len(result.failures)})
s=Path(__file__).read_text()
(root/'collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch10-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'batch':10,'results':results,'procedure_source':s,'procedure_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(len(results),'种变异检出，源码已恢复')
